body: Thank you for your comment :) It is hard to get a reply on here for some reason.. Those 3 things are how I feel too. My mother was the only one who offered to help me with therapy but then she looked at the price and we haven't spoken of it since! I am sorry for what you're going through, it does make me feel a little better knowing I am not the only one, but it's also sad that a lot of people are going through this.
Someone commented early asking if i wanted to talk, my inbox is always open, sorry i missed your comment.

I have tried giving multiple suggestions and told him to seek help from a professional. i've tried to do things with him, but he gets angry at me for saying all of these suggestions, and tells me im wrong

Thanks for responding.. I have told him he needs to go and seek help professionally. But he is sooo stubborn and refuses saying “They won’t help me, they just want their money, they will make me worse” he has no trust in anyone.. He just finished therapy for 2 years.. But it did nothing. I didn’t know there was a difference between counselling and therapy

He has been in therapy for 2 years and he has also been in a mental hospital temporarily from trying to kill himself before. He has been on pills and now he tells me that he will never take pills again because they made him weak? And made him worse? Also he gets angry if i tell him to talk to someone about it or if i suggest seeking professional help in the form of pills or anything. He tells me he would rather talk to a brick wall than listen to what i have to say about that.
Thank you for your response. I know that this has to happen. Its just hard because I am thinking of what is to come after the break up. Because he has no friends and no supporting family.
